title: Server Dynamic Lights
description: Completely Serverside dynamic lights mod for fabric, no client mod needed, supporting geyser players aswell.
body:
# **Server Dynamic Lights** A simple Fabric mod that adds server side dynamic lights, no client mod needed, and also supports geyser players. Right now, it supports most vanilla light items mainly torches and lanterns. ## Usage: * Its dead simple, drop the mod into the mods folder along with the areed's corelib. (it depends on Areed's Corelib) * Thats it, now you can have any torch or lantern in either hand, and it will emit light without placing down. * The way it works is sending fake light packets, no real light blocks are ever placed in your world. in future, I will add more support for maybe modded items, and more light emiting things in game :} thats about it, its as simple as that. *** **If you want a cheap and extremely good server, check out gravelhost, use my link or the code for 25% off for your purchase.**  [![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1376188/description_ab3820b9-fecf-4a0c-9f15-576b2c9c0323.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=https%253a%252f%252fgravelhost.com%252fareedelahi)
